stale-app.request: After changing to a light theme, the shell updates but my still-open paint app stays dark. Diagnose the owner of the problem from these files. Do not edit files or restart anything.
stale-app.response_plain_text:
The problem belongs to the paint app’s theme consumer: it caches the palette at startup and never reloads it.
Both theme/colors.toml and current/theme/colors.toml contain the same light colours: foreground #111111, background #ffffff.
app/theme-reader.py reads the file once into PALETTE; current_palette() always returns that cached value.
observations.txt reports no watcher or user override, and says a previous reopening loaded the light colours.
The concrete next step is an app-side change to detect theme changes, reread the current palette, and update existing UI bindings. Then verify light → dark → light switching while the app remains open.
